summary.name: MacZip
summary.one_liner: MacZip (formerly eZip) is a macOS archive manager that lets you view, search, preview, compress, and encrypt ZIP, RAR, 7Z and many other archive formats.
use_cases: Extract ZIP, RAR, or 7Z files on a Mac
Preview archive contents with Quick Look in Finder
Encrypt or decrypt multiple files in bulk
Search for files inside an archive by keyword
summary.what_it_does: MacZip lets users view and edit archives without decompressing them, supporting read access to formats such as zip, rar, 7z, gz, iso, tgz, tar, xz, bz2, zst, and cab, among others. It offers one-click filtering for images and documents and keyword search within archives. Selected files can be previewed directly, and archives can be previewed via Quick Look by pressing space in Finder. It supports encrypted rar, zip, and 7z archives, bulk encryption and decryption, and Finder services for extracting and compressing. The page lists version history up to V2.4 (2024/02/01).
notable: Read and preview archive contents without extracting, including Quick Look from Finder
Supports a wide range of formats including ZIP, RAR, 7Z, ISO, TAR variants, and CAB
Finder extension and services for compressing, extracting, encrypting and decrypting
Sandboxed app that requests only basic sandbox permissions
caveats: Due to sandbox limits, it cannot set the file open mode itself; a separate MacZip Assistant applet is needed for that
It checks for updates by sending device-derived tag, system version/language and app version to the server
The author does not provide password storage or recovery; losing an encryption password is the user's responsibility
